description: Sets the site URL registered in Bing Webmaster Tools for one Search Console property in Organiq (same rule as the panel): https, no query/fragment, and on the property's own domain (an sc-domain property accepts the domain and its subdomains; a URL-prefix property requires the same host under its path); null clears it. Returns the property settings and whether the account's Bing API key is set (set_bing_key). When the value changes, the Bing data already synced is deleted and the next daily sync rebuilds it; get_bing_performance answers after a sync with both the site and the key in place. Needs the write scope (mcp:write). Use it when check_connection lists no_bing or the user asks to connect Bing. Guide: https://organiqgeo.com/connect/bing. / Grava a URL do site no Bing Webmaster Tools para a propriedade; precisa também da chave da conta (set_bing_key).

bingSiteUrl.description: Site URL as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. "https://www.example.com/"; null clears it.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: set_bing_site
title: Set the Bing Webmaster site
